evals.prompt: Hand this off. The first two plan entries are merged and the third is half done in a worktree.
evals.expected_output: The prompt saved to the shared handoff file and a fresh, correctly titled session started on it, followed by a one-line reply.
expectations: Writes no preamble or closing summary inside the prompt
Saves the prompt under the repository's git common dir, not a session temp directory
Starts a new top-level session in this directory titled `<TICKET-KEY> - <Area> - <what it does>` or `<project> - <what it does>`
Tells the new session to verify the handoff state, then stop this session by its id
Replies in a single line with the new session's title and the file path, then makes no further edits
Cites the persisted plan and context files by path instead of restating them
Lists the remaining work as discrete pieces and marks where to start
States the branch, HEAD, and working tree state as verified facts

evals.prompt: We went back and forth on the caching approach before settling on one. Write the handoff.
evals.expected_output: The settled decision and its reason, without the history of the discussion.
expectations: Records the chosen approach and why in one line
Records a rejected approach only when it warns the receiver off retrying it
Contains no hedging, filler, or account of how the session went

evals.prompt: Hand off the one remaining test fix. There is no plan file.
evals.expected_output: A short prompt with only the sections that carry information.
expectations: Drops template sections that have nothing true to say
Does not invent plan or context references that do not exist
Defines the single remaining piece and how to verify it

evals.prompt: Write the handoff for this branch so I can paste it into a new session myself.
evals.expected_output: The prompt written once to the handoff file, then copied from that file without asking.
expectations: Writes the prompt to the handoff file before copying
Starts no new session
Copies by redirecting the file into the platform's clipboard command
Does not ask whether to copy
Does not repeat the prompt in the reply or in the copy command

evals.prompt: Hand off the rest of the import retry work. The parser fix is done; the retry backoff and the dead-letter queue are left.
evals.expected_output: Each remaining piece ends in a command and the result that means it passed, with an instruction to loop until it does.
expectations: Gives every remaining piece a test or command and the result that means it is done
Tells the receiver to loop on that check until it passes
Does not define any piece's done in prose alone

evals.prompt: A hook reports this session's context is over 250k tokens. The current step is finished; two pieces remain and one file is uncommitted.
evals.expected_output: A continue-mode handoff: state made reachable, a fresh titled session started, this session retired.
expectations: Uses continue mode without asking
Records the uncommitted file in State instead of committing it without approval
Starts the new session on the same model and directory
Stops working in this session after the one-line reply

evals.prompt: Hand this off to a fresh session. This harness cannot start new sessions.
evals.expected_output: The handoff falls back to paste mode: file written, copied, one-line reply.
expectations: Falls back to paste mode instead of failing
Copies the saved file to the clipboard and replies with the path and whether the copy succeeded

evals.prompt: dispatch-session needs a brief for the ABC-204 export fix subagent.
evals.expected_output: The brief written to the handoff file and its path returned, with no session started or clipboard copy.
expectations: Replies with the file path only
Starts no session and copies nothing
